title: Good slicing level and subsequence for restrictions of cycles
statement: Assume SlicingTheorem and the statement (RWL) of iwl_restriction_weak_limit (its exact frozen Lean type, as an antecedent). Let P, m ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, W ⊂⊂ U (CompactlyContainedOpen W U), X_k, X ∈ D_{m+1}(U) (k ∈ ℕ) with ∂X_k = 0 for every k, M_V(X_k) < ∞ for every k and every V ⊂⊂ U, sup_k M_W(X_k) < ∞ and X_k ⇀ X. Let d : ℝ^P → ℝ be L-Lipschitz (L ∈ ℝ≥0) and a < b. Then there are γ ∈ (a, b), a strictly increasing κ : ℕ → ℕ, currents R_k ∈ D_{m+1}(U) and G ∈ [0, ∞) such that, with A_γ := {x ∈ U : d(x) < γ}: for every k, R_k is a restriction of X_{κ(k)} to A_γ, M_W(R_k) ≤ M_W(X_{κ(k)}) and M_W(∂R_k) ≤ G; and for every restriction R of X to A_γ and every ω ∈ D^{m+1}(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ W, R_k(ω) → R(ω).
lean_statement: SlicingTheorem → (∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (Xj : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U k) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U k) (W : Set (Eucl P)) (φ : Eucl P → ℝ), WeaklyConvergesOn Xj X → IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → (⨆ j, (Xj j).massOn W) < ∞ → ContinuousOn φ U → ∃ (ψ : ℕ → ℕ) (E : Set ℝ), StrictMono ψ ∧ E.Countable ∧ ∀ s ∉ E, ∀ (Rj : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U k) (R : GeometricCurrentOn U k), (∀ j, IsRestriction (Xj (ψ j)) {x | x ∈ U ∧ φ x < s} (Rj j)) → IsRestriction X {x | x ∈ U ∧ φ x < s} R → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) ⊆ W → Tendsto (fun j => Rj j ω) atTop (𝓝 (R ω))) ∧ (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ W → {x | x ∈ U ∧ φ x ≤ s} ⊆ K → WeaklyConvergesOn Rj R)) → ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U W : Set (Eucl P)) (Xk : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (d : Eucl P → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (a b : ℝ), IsOpen U → CompactlyContainedOpen W U → LipschitzWith L d → a < b → (∀ k, (Xk k).boundary = 0) → (∀ k V, CompactlyContainedOpen V U → (Xk k).massOn V < ∞) → (⨆ k, (Xk k).massOn W) < ∞ → WeaklyConvergesOn Xk X → ∃ (γ : ℝ) (κ : ℕ → ℕ) (Rk : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (G : ℝ≥0∞), γ ∈ Ioo a b ∧ StrictMono κ ∧ G < ∞ ∧ (∀ k, IsRestriction (Xk (κ k)) {x | x ∈ U ∧ d x < γ} (Rk k)) ∧ (∀ k, (Rk k).massOn W ≤ (Xk (κ k)).massOn W) ∧ (∀ k, (Rk k).boundary.massOn W ≤ G) ∧ ∀ R : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1), IsRestriction X {x | x ∈ U ∧ d x < γ} R → ∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) (m + 1)) ⊆ W → Tendsto (fun k => Rk k ω) atTop (𝓝 (R ω))
